name: agentextension
description: Reviewable coding changes in VS Code, powered by local TrueForge.

agentextension.model.description: Model name from TrueForge, including the provider prefix.

agentextension.compaction.description: Let TrueForge compact long histories. Disable this if your model template requires an original user message.

agentextension.turnTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time for a streamed TrueForge turn.

agentextension.workerTimeoutSeconds.description: Deadline for each worker session, including one retry. Local models may need 120 to 180 seconds.

agentextension.fallbackModel.description: Optional second TrueForge model used when the primary model fails.

agentextension.skillRoots.description: Approved local folders containing skill-name/SKILL.md directories. Skills load only when selected. Scripts never run.

agentextension.readConnectors.description: User-reviewed read-only MCP tools. Enable them per workspace in the panel. Use HTTPS or loopback HTTP. Store credentials with the Connector credential button.

agentextension.pluginRoots.description: Approved local folders containing plugin directories with plugin.json. Installation does not enable a plugin. Review its version, content digest and capabilities in Manage plugins.

agentextension.browserOrigins.description: Exact HTTPS origins or loopback HTTP origins available for explicit browser access. Select origins and interaction mode in the panel. No wildcard origins.

maxTokens.description: Input plus output tokens across the agent and its workers. 0 means no limit.

maxMinutes.description: Run time in minutes. 0 means no limit.

maxToolCalls.description: Editor tool calls, including worker calls. 0 means no limit.

agentextension.runBudget.markdownDescription: Limits for one agent run. After a limit is reached, only `review_changes` still runs, so staged work can be reviewed. At 125% of the token or time limit the run is cancelled.

agentextension.userInstructions.markdownDescription: Optional standing instructions sent with every agent run, for example your preferred test command or writing style. Up to 4,000 characters. Instructions cannot grant tools or change approvals. Workspace settings cannot set this value.

agentextension.automaticSkills.description: Load up to two skills from approved roots when their name and description match the request. Skills marked disable-model-invocation or allow_implicit_invocation: false are never matched. The run shows each matched skill and the terms that matched.

agentextension.permissionRules.markdownDescription: User permission rules for every workspace. Each rule has an `effect`, a `target` with `*` wildcards, and a `decision` of `allow`, `ask` or `deny`. Administrator rules apply first. Allow rules are limited to `command.execute`, `connector.read`, `browser.write` and `computer.write`, and need a specific target. Workspace settings cannot set this value.

agentextension.scheduledReports.description: Run approved read-only scheduled reports while VS Code is open with their trusted workspace. Turn off to stop all schedules on this machine. Schedules are created and approved in the Agent panel.

agentextension.browserExecutable.description: Optional absolute Chrome or Chromium executable path. Empty uses installed Google Chrome. The extension always creates its own profile.
